description: 8-class label -> IDPS action. DoS and DDoS deliberately share one action (the classes the model confuses most).

action_meaning.BLOCK: rate-limit the source (volumetric attack): iptables hashlimit drop above the threshold
action_meaning.ALERT: forward the flow and raise an alert for the analyst (reconnaissance is not blocked, to avoid blocking scanners on false positives)
action_meaning.BLOCK+ALERT: drop all traffic from the source and raise an alert

placeholder_ip_range: 203.0.113.0/24 (RFC 5737 TEST-NET-3; CICIoT2023 rows carry no IP addresses)
